entries.jp: 全部　俺の奢りだ！\nじゃんじゃん\n持ってきてくれ！
entries.en: It's all on me!\nKeep it coming!

entries.jp: あらぁ　こちら\nずいぶんと男前ねえ！\n惚れちゃいそうだわぁ
entries.en:
Oh my, aren't
you a handsome
one! I might
just fall for you!

entries.jp: おう　嬉しいことを\n言ってくれるなぁ！
entries.en: Ho, now that's\nnice to hear!

entries.jp: 俺の愛人になるか？\nん？
entries.en: How'd you\nlike to be my\nmistress? Hm?

entries.jp: またまた\n本気にしちゃうわよ～！
entries.en: Oh, you! I\nmight take\nthat seriously~!

entries.jp: げほっ　げほげほっ！\n給仕のお嬢さん達も\nずいぶんと可愛らしいな
entries.en:
*Cough, cough!*
The young
ladies serving
here are quite
the lookers, too.

entries.jp: あ……あの……\n愛人は\n結構ですので……
entries.en:
Um... uh... I'll
pass on being
a mistress,
thank you...

entries.jp: 注文のピッツァを置くと\n幾松は逃げるようにして\n厨房へと戻っていった
entries.en:
Setting down
the pizza
they'd ordered,
Ikumatsu fled
back to the
kitchen.

entries.jp: これがぴっつぁか\n初めて食うが……
entries.en: So this is a\npeetsa... First time\nI've ever had it...

entries.jp: 先生　これはな\n端を　ちょいとつまみ\nこうクルクルと丸めたら
entries.en:
Sensei, see, you
pinch the edge
a bit and roll it
up like this...

entries.jp: 口を　あーんと開けて\n一気に頬張るぜよ！
entries.en: ...then open wide\nand chomp it\ndown in one go!

entries.jp: ほほう\nこうして　こうか？\nでは　いただこう
entries.en: Ho ho. Like this,\nthen like this?\nWell, let's dig in.

entries.jp: うまいっ
entries.en: Delicious!

entries.jp: じゃろ？　この食べ方は\nテンちゃん……いや\n松陰先生に教わったぜよ
entries.en:
Right? I learned
to eat it this way
from Ten-chan...
I mean,
Shoin-sensei!

entries.jp: そうか　これも\nショウの教えか\nそうか……
entries.en: I see. So this was\nShow's teaching\ntoo... I see...

entries.jp: 勝先生\nそろそろいいか？\n話を聞かせてくれ
entries.en:
Katsu-sensei, is
it time yet? Tell
us what you
came to say.

entries.jp: む？　ああ\nそうだったな
entries.en: Hm? Ah,\nthat's right.

entries.jp: まず　俺の立場を\n説明しておいた方が\n良さそうだ
entries.en:
Guess I'd
better start by
explaining
where I stand.

entries.jp: ええ\nお願いします
entries.en: Yes, please.

entries.jp: 龍馬達も知っての通り\nお前達の雷舞を\n俺は毎日のように観ていた
entries.en:
As you all know,
Ryoma, I've
watched your
live shows just
about every day.

entries.jp: お前達のロックには\n力がある
entries.en: Your rock has\nreal power.

entries.jp: 佐幕も倒幕も越えて\nお前達の歌は　今の\n時代に必要だと感じた
entries.en:
Pro-shogunate,
anti-shogunate,
none of that
matters. I felt
this era needs
your songs.

entries.jp: だが　見ていたところ\n少々旗色が悪そうじゃ\nねえか？
entries.en:
But from what
I've seen, the
tide's turning
against you a
bit, ain't it?

entries.jp: ……勝先生の\n言うとおりだ\n悔しいが
entries.en: ...Katsu-sensei's\nright. Much\nas it galls me.

entries.jp: ここで　お前さん達が\n幕府に潰されちまうのは\n面白くねえ
entries.en:
It'd be no fun
watching you
kids get
crushed by the
shogunate here.

entries.jp: 何よりも　ショウに\n面目が立たないと\n思ってな
entries.en:
More than
anything, I
figured I couldn't
face Show if I let
that happen.

entries.jp: 助け船のひとつも\n出そうかと思って\nやってきた
entries.en:
So I came by
thinking I'd
throw you a
lifeline or two.

entries.jp: ええと　それは\n勝先生が　私達に\n協力してくれる……
entries.en:
Um, so
Katsu-sensei
will cooperate
with us...

entries.jp: ということですか？
entries.en: ...is that right?

entries.jp: 要らぬ世話かもしれんが\nそのつもりだ
entries.en:
Might be sticking
my nose where it
ain't wanted, but
that's the idea.

entries.jp: とっ\nとんでもない！
entries.en: N-not at all!

entries.jp: 勝先生の助力があれば\n八方塞がりだった\n状況を打破できます
entries.en:
With your help,
Katsu-sensei,
we can break
out of this dead
end we've been
backed into.

entries.jp: はしゃぐな　桂
entries.en: Don't get carried\naway, Katsura.

entries.jp: それで勝先生\nどんなご助力を\nいただけるのです？
entries.en:
So, Katsu-sensei.
What kind of
help can we
expect from you?

entries.jp: 情報を　みっつ\n持ってきた
entries.en: I've brought three\npieces of news.

entries.jp: いい話と　悪い話と\nお前らがぶっ飛ぶ話だ\nどれから聞きてえ？
entries.en:
Good news, bad
news, and news
that'll knock your
socks off. Which
do you wanna
hear first?

entries.jp: 勝の言葉に\n五人はお互いの\n顔を見合わせる
entries.en:
At Katsu's
words, the five
exchanged
glances.

entries.jp: では\nいい話からお願いします
entries.en: Then the good\nnews first, please.

entries.jp: 良かろう
entries.en: Fair enough.

entries.jp: お前達を付け狙っていた\n井伊直弼は　今　京には\nいない
entries.en:
Naosuke Ii, the
man who's been
hunting you,
isn't in Kyoto
right now.

entries.jp: 近い内に　戒厳令も\n解かれるはずだ
entries.en: The martial law\nshould be lifted\nbefore long, too.

entries.jp: じゃあ　もう少し\n我慢すれば　雷舞も\nやり放題ってことか
entries.en:
So if we just
hang on a little
longer, we can
do as many
lives as we like!

entries.jp: それはどうだろうな
entries.en: I wouldn't\nbe so sure.

entries.jp: え？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: では　悪い話というのを\n聞かせてもらえますか
entries.en: Then may\nwe hear the\nbad news?

entries.jp:
幕府が――いや井伊が
かなり大がかりな祭
（フェスティバル）
を企画している
entries.en:
The shogunate...
no, Ii is planning
one heck of a big
festival.

entries.jp:
その名も
 nt1大江戸天歌祭 nt0
（おおえどヘブン
フェスティバル）
entries.en:
It goes by the
name... the  nt1Great
Edo Heaven's
Song Festival nt0.

entries.jp: 大江戸天歌……祭……
entries.en: The Great Edo\nHeaven's Song...\nFestival...

entries.jp: 江戸を中心に　京　大坂\n尾張　福岡の　巨大雷舞\n会場で同時に開催される
entries.en:
It's to be held all
at once in giant
live venues in
Edo, Kyoto,
Osaka, Owari and
Fukuoka, with
Edo at the center.

entries.jp: 天歌の歌い手を一堂に集め\n民衆の泰平化を　一気に\n推し進めるつもりらしい
entries.en:
Seems he wants
to gather all the
Heaven's Song
singers in one
place and pacify
the people in
one fell swoop.

entries.jp: な　なんだって？\n井伊の野郎　とんでもねえ\nことを企んでやがる！
entries.en:
Wh-what did you
say? That bastard
Ii's cooking up
something insane!

entries.jp: その天歌祭とやら\n乗り込んでブッ潰すしか\nねえな……
entries.en:
Guess there's
nothing for it
but to storm
this Heaven's
Song Festival
and smash it...

entries.jp: でも　全国の五箇所で\n同時に行われるんですよ？\nひとつだけ潰しても……
entries.en:
But it's being
held in five
places across the
country at the
same time, you
know? Even if we
only crush one...

entries.jp: 話は最後まで聞け
entries.en: Hear me out\nto the end.

entries.jp: 天歌祭は　どうやら\n江戸の会場が中心に\nなるらしい
entries.en:
Seems the Edo
venue will be
the heart of
the Heaven's
Song Festival.

entries.jp:
江戸から　井伊の術で
全国の会場へ天歌の力
（パワー）を送り込む
という
entries.en:
Word is, Ii's
technique will
send Heaven's
Song's power
from Edo out to
the venues all
over the country.

entries.jp: 天歌祭が執り行われれば\n泰平化は　取り返しが\nつかんほど進行するだろう
entries.en:
If the Heaven's
Song Festival
goes ahead,
the pacification
will spread
past any hope
of undoing it.

entries.jp: そんな計画が\n進んでいたなんて\n全く知りませんでした
entries.en: I had no idea a\nplan like that\nwas underway.

entries.jp: 井伊は　その調整の\nために　全国を回って\nいる
entries.en: Ii's traveling the\nwhole country to\nget it all set up.

entries.jp: もはや　お前達のロック\nなど　井伊の眼中に\nないというわけだ
entries.en:
In other words,
your rock isn't
even on Ii's
radar anymore.

entries.jp: そ　そんな……
entries.en: N-no way...

entries.jp:
勝から聞かされた
天歌祭の計画は
龍馬達　志士にとって
死刑宣告に他ならない
entries.en:
The Heaven's
Song Festival
plan Katsu
described was
nothing short of
a death sentence
for Ryoma and
his fellow rebels.

entries.jp: 龍馬達の間を\n重い沈黙が流れる
entries.en:
A heavy
silence settled
over Ryoma
and the others.

entries.jp: その沈黙を破ったのは\n高杉だった
entries.en: It was Takasugi\nwho broke that\nsilence.

entries.jp: 勝先生\n話はみっつあると\n言ったはずだ
entries.en:
Katsu-sensei,
you said you
had three
pieces of news.

entries.jp: 最後の　オレ様達が\nぶっ飛ぶ話ってのは\n何なんだ？
entries.en:
So what's this
last one, the one
that's supposed
to knock our
socks off?

entries.jp: その話をする前に\nひとつ聞いておきたい
entries.en: Before I tell you,\nthere's one thing\nI want to ask.

entries.jp: お前達　幕府と\n真っ正面からケンカを\nする気はあるか？
entries.en:
Have you kids
got the guts to
pick a fight with
the shogunate
head-on?

entries.jp: 当たり前だ！\nオレ様達は　これまでも\nそのつもりでやってきた！
entries.en:
Obviously! That's
what yours truly
and the rest of
us have been
doing all along!

entries.jp: 突風雷舞や　新選組の\n舞台に飛び込むのとは\nケタが違う話だ
entries.en:
This is a whole
other league
from guerrilla
lives or crashing
the Shinsengumi's
stage.

entries.jp: ケタなんて関係ねえ\nやるか　やらないかだ
entries.en:
League's got
nothing to do
with it. Either you
do it or you don't.

entries.jp: そして　オレ様達は\n絶対に退かねえ！\nそれがロックだぜ
entries.en:
And the great
Takasugi never
backs down!
That's rock!

entries.jp: 高杉の言葉に　他の\n仲間達が力強く頷く
entries.en: At Takasugi's\nwords, the others\nnodded firmly.

entries.jp: それを見て\n勝も決心したようだ
entries.en: Seeing this, Katsu\nseemed to make\nup his mind.

entries.jp: よし　お前達\n天歌祭を乗っ取れ
entries.en:
All right, you
kids. Hijack
the Heaven's
Song Festival.

entries.jp: 天歌祭を乗っ取る\nど　どうやって？
entries.en: Hijack the\nHeaven's Song\nFestival? H-how?

entries.jp: 俺が何とかして\n天歌の歌い手として\nお前達をねじ込んでやる
entries.en:
One way or
another, I'll
squeeze you
in as Heaven's
Song singers.

entries.jp: お前達は　江戸の\n本会場で舞台に\n上がって――
entries.en: You'll take the\nstage at the main\nvenue in Edo--

entries.jp: 最高のロックを\n派手にぶちかませ！
entries.en:
--and blast out
the best rock
you've got, loud
and proud!

entries.jp: そうすれば　お前達の\nロックは　井伊の術で\n全国にばらまかれる！
entries.en:
Do that, and Ii's
own technique
will scatter your
rock all across
the country!

entries.jp: どうする？\n強要はしねえ
entries.en: What'll it be? I\nwon't force you.

entries.jp: 一回限りの\n出たとこ勝負だ
entries.en: It's a one-shot\ndeal. You'll be\nwinging it.

entries.jp: 江戸の本会場には\n井伊大老も顔を見せる\nはずだ
entries.en:
Great Elder Ii
ought to show his
face at the main
venue in Edo, too.

entries.jp: 井伊と　正面から\nぶつかり合う局面に\nなるやもしれん
entries.en:
It may well
come down
to a head-on
clash with Ii.

entries.jp: それこそ\n望むところだぜ
entries.en: That's exactly\nwhat I'm\nhoping for.

entries.jp: 地道に突風雷舞を\n重ねていくのも\n考えのひとつだろう
entries.en:
Sure, steadily
piling up
guerrilla lives
is one way to
go about it.

entries.jp: ですが　天歌祭が\n行われてしまえば\n私達にも後はありません
entries.en:
But once the
Heaven's Song
Festival
happens, there'll
be no future left
for us either.

entries.jp: 井伊の思惑を利用して\nロックを広める絶好の\n機会でもあるわけだ……
entries.en:
It's also the
perfect chance to
use Ii's scheme to
spread rock...

entries.jp: 勝先生\nオレ様達は志士だぜ
entries.en: Katsu-sensei,\nwe're rebels.

entries.jp: ノるか　ソるか\nそういう話なら　ノらない\nヤツは　ここにはいねえ
entries.en:
If it's hit it or
quit it, there's
nobody here
who'd sit it out.

entries.jp: ちょっと　スカシくん\n勝手に決めないでよ！\n僕はやるなんて一言も
entries.en:
Hey, Mr. Poser,
don't go deciding
for everyone! I
never said I'd do
it!

entries.jp: あん？　腰抜けの弱虫は\nオレ様でも土方でもなく\n沖田　お前だったのか？
entries.en:
Huh? So the
spineless coward
wasn't me or
Hijikata... it was
you, Okita?

entries.jp: はあ？　僕はスカシくんの\nヘボい技術を　心配して\nやってるだけだろ！
entries.en:
Hah? I'm only
worried about
your lousy
skills, Mr. Poser!

entries.jp: ゴタクはいらねえ\nノるのか？　降りるのか？\nそれだけを答えろ
entries.en:
Spare me the
blather. You in
or out? That's all
I wanna hear.

entries.jp: ノるさ！\n当たり前だろ！
entries.en: I'm in! Of\ncourse I am!

entries.jp: あとは坂本\nお前だけだが……\nどうする？
entries.en: That just leaves\nyou, Sakamoto...\nWhat'll it be?

entries.jp: 江戸のみならず\n日本中を　ロックの\n虜にしてやるぜよ！
entries.en:
Not just Edo...
I'll get all of
Japan hooked on
rock, I tell ya!

entries.jp: わっはっはっは！\nよし　決まりだ！
entries.en: Wahahaha! All\nright, it's settled!

entries.jp: お前達\n江戸へ向かえ！
entries.en: You kids,\nhead for Edo!

entries.jp: 天歌祭に潜り込む\n手立ては追って報せる
entries.en:
I'll send word
later on how to
sneak you into
the Heaven's
Song Festival.

entries.jp: 井伊の企み\n何としても潰さなければ\nなりません！
entries.en: We must crush\nIi's scheme, no\nmatter what!

entries.jp: 松陰先生の教え　即ち\nロックこそが正義だって\nことを知らしめてやるぜ！
entries.en:
I'll show 'em
Shoin-sensei's
teaching: that
rock is justice!

entries.jp: 今こそ　近藤さんの\n遺志を果たすときが\n来たようだ
entries.en:
It seems the time
has come to carry
out Kondo-san's
last wish.

entries.jp: 何しろ僕は天才だからね\n任せておいてよ
entries.en: I'm a genius,\nafter all.\nLeave it to me.

entries.jp: うおおおおお！\nわしらの歌で――
entries.en: Whoooooa! With\nour songs--

entries.jp: 大江戸天歌祭を\n大江戸ロック祭に\nしてやるぜよ
entries.en:
--we'll turn
the Great Edo
Heaven's Song
Festival into
the Great Edo
Rock Festival!

entries.jp: そうして五人は勝海舟の\n命を受け　さっそく江戸へ\n向かって出立したのだった
entries.en:
And so, under
orders from
Kaishu Katsu,
the five set
out for Edo
without delay.

entries.jp: 旅程は滞りなく進み\n龍馬達は予定通りに\n江戸へ辿り着いた
entries.en:
The journey went
smoothly, and
Ryoma and the
others reached
Edo right on
schedule.

entries.jp: そして　数日後――\n大江戸天歌祭の当日
entries.en:
Then, a few
days later-- the
day of the Great
Edo Heaven's
Song Festival.

entries.jp: 龍馬達は　江戸の本会場の\n舞台へ乗り込んだ
entries.en:
Ryoma and the
others marched
onto the stage
of the main
venue in Edo.

entries.jp:
祭会場の舞台袖では
早馬で駆けつけた
勝海舟が　五人を
待ちかまえていた
entries.en:
In the wings of
the festival
stage, Kaishu
Katsu, who had
rushed there
on a fast horse,
was waiting for
the five.

entries.jp: お前達\nよく来たな
entries.en: Good, you\nmade it.

entries.jp: お前達の出番は\n一番手だ
entries.en: You're up first.

entries.jp: 天歌で民衆が泰平化\nされちまう前に
entries.en: Before Heaven's\nSong pacifies\nthe crowd...

entries.jp: お前達のロックを\nぶちかませ！
entries.en: ...blast 'em\nwith your rock!

entries.jp: おう
entries.en: You got it.

entries.jp: 力強く　そう答えてから\n龍馬は　すでに満員の\n会場をぐるりと見渡した
entries.en:
After answering
firmly, Ryoma
looked all around
the already
packed venue.

entries.jp: さすがは　江戸ぜよ\nこんなに大勢のお客が\n入っとるのか
entries.en:
That's Edo for
ya! Look at all
these folks
packed in here!

entries.jp: 緊張しますね……\n他のみんなは\n大丈夫でしょうか
entries.en:
I'm nervous...
I wonder if
everyone else
is all right.

entries.jp: 龍馬の心配をする
entries.en: Worry about\nRyoma

entries.jp: 沖田の心配をする
entries.en: Worry\nabout Okita

entries.jp: 自分の心配をする
entries.en: Worry about\nyourself

entries.jp: 龍馬くん\n大丈夫ですか？
entries.en: Ryoma-kun, are\nyou all right?

entries.jp: 早く歌いたくて\nうずうずするぜよ！
entries.en: I'm just itchin'\nto get out\nthere and sing!

entries.jp: 龍馬くんの心配は\nしなくてもよさそう\nですね……
entries.en: It seems I needn't\nworry about\nRyoma-kun...

entries.jp: 沖田くん\n大丈夫ですか？
entries.en: Okita-kun, are\nyou all right?

entries.jp: 僕が緊張なんて\nするわけないでしょ
entries.en: As if I'd ever\nget nervous.

entries.jp: でも\n震えてますよ？
entries.en: But you're\nshaking,\nyou know?

entries.jp: こ　これは\n武者震いだよ！
entries.en: Th-this is just\nme raring to go!

entries.jp: 観客が何人いても\n同じ事さ
entries.en: Doesn't matter\nhow big the\ncrowd is.

entries.jp: カボチャ以下のボンクラ\n相手に緊張する必要も\nないだろ
entries.en:
No need to get
nervous in front
of a bunch of
blockheads
worth less than
pumpkins.

entries.jp: そうそう　いつもの\nその調子でお願いします
entries.en:
Yes, yes. Keep
that usual
attitude of yours
going, please.

entries.jp: 他人の心配をしている\n場合じゃないですね
entries.en: This is no time\nto be worrying\nabout others.

entries.jp: 深呼吸をしよう\nすーっ\nはーっ
entries.en: Let me take a\ndeep breath.\nSuuu... haaa...

entries.jp: 少し落ち着いたかな……
entries.en: I think I've\ncalmed down\na little...

entries.jp: これだけの大舞台だ\n緊張するのは仕方ない\nだが　萎縮するなよ
entries.en:
Nerves are only
natural on a stage
this big. Just don't
freeze up.

entries.jp: この大勢の観客が\nロックに目覚めるか\n否かは　お前達次第だ
entries.en:
Whether this
huge crowd
wakes up to
rock or not
is up to you.

entries.jp: 舞台に上がってしまえば\n俺はもう手助けは出来ねえ
entries.en:
Once you're
on that stage,
I can't help
you anymore.

entries.jp: 龍馬　高杉　桂\nそして　土方　沖田
entries.en: Ryoma, Takasugi,\nKatsura. And\nHijikata, Okita.

entries.jp: 頼んだぞ
entries.en: I'm counting\non you.

entries.jp: おう！
entries.en: You got it!

entries.jp: ご期待に沿えるよう\n精一杯頑張ります
entries.en: I'll do my very\nbest to live up to\nyour expectations.

entries.jp: 松陰先生\n見ていてください\nオレの本気を……！
entries.en: Shoin-sensei,\nwatch me... This\nis me for real...!

entries.jp: 総司\n気合入れていくぞ
entries.en: Soji. Let's put\nsome fire into it.

entries.jp: わかりました\nでも土方さん\n肩に力入り過ぎですよ？
entries.en:
Got it. But
Hijikata-san,
aren't your
shoulders a
bit too tense?

entries.jp: うっ……　きょ\n今日はこのくらいで\n丁度いいんだ
entries.en: Ugh... T-today,\nthis much is\njust right.

entries.jp: 本日は\n大江戸天歌祭に\nご来場いただきまして
entries.en:
Thank you all
for attending
the Great Edo
Heaven's Song
Festival today...

entries.jp: 誠にありがとうございます
entries.en: ...we are truly\ngrateful.

entries.jp: 会場の案内が流れる中\n舞台が明るく照らし出された
entries.en:
As the venue
announcement
played, the stage
lit up brightly.

entries.jp: よぉぉぉっし
entries.en: All riiiight!

entries.jp: センセーの先生\n勝のおっさん　\n行ってくるぜよ！
entries.en: Sensei's sensei!\nOld man Katsu!\nHere we go!

entries.jp: 龍馬とその仲間達は\n大きく手を振りながら\n眩い輝きの中へ駆け出す
entries.en:
Ryoma and his
comrades ran out
into the dazzling
light, waving
their arms wide.

entries.jp:
幕府のお膝元　江戸で
前代未聞のロック祭が
いよいよ
始まろうとしていた
entries.en:
In Edo, the
shogunate's own
backyard, an
unprecedented
rock festival
was finally
about to begin.

entries.jp: 巨大な会場を埋め尽くした\n観客達の視線が　龍馬達に\n注がれている
entries.en:
The eyes of the
audience filling
the enormous
venue were
fixed on Ryoma
and the others.

entries.jp: それじゃ……\n始めるぜよ
entries.en: Well then... let's\nget this started,\nI tell ya.

entries.jp:
高らかに鳴り響いた
ギターの音に
観客も警備の武士達も
一斉に目を丸くした
entries.en:
At the guitar
ringing out
loud and clear,
the audience
and the samurai
guards alike
went wide-eyed
all at once.

entries.jp: 天歌を期待しとった\nみんなには悪いが―
entries.en:
Sorry to everyone
who was expectin'
Heaven's Song,
but--

entries.jp: わしらのロックで\n目を覚ますぜよ
entries.en: --our rock's gonna\nwake you up!

entries.jp: 自由を！\n熱情を！\n魂を取り戻せ
entries.en: Freedom!\nPassion! Take\nback your souls!

entries.jp: よぉぉぉぉしゃああ！\n燃えてきた燃えてきた\n燃えてきたぜよぉぉぉ
entries.en:
Yeeeeaaaah!
I'm fired up,
fired up, I'm all
fired uuuup!

entries.jp: ああ……わしの中で\n何かが迸る……
entries.en: Ahh... something's\nsurging up inside\nme...

entries.jp: みんなに届けたいと\n叫ぶんじゃ
entries.en: It's screamin'\nthat it wants to\nreach everybody!

entries.jp: これがロックじゃ！\nわしのロックで痺れるぜよぉ
entries.en: This is rock! My\nrock's gonna\nelectrify ya!
